component.name: subedit
component.summary: Read, inspect and retime subtitle files

description.p: subedit opens SubRip and WebVTT subtitle files, shows them in a table, and edits them cell by cell. It plays the film the file accompanies in its own window, with the current line drawn over the picture, so that a correction can be checked against what it is meant to match.
Its operations act on the selection, or on the whole file:

ul.li: shift every position by a fixed amount
correct every position from two points known to be right
re-time a file mastered at one frame rate for another
move every position onto the nearest frame of a frame rate
remove the sounds described between brackets or parentheses

description.p: It also deduces, from the positions alone, the frame rate a file was written against — a subtitle file declares none — and says how well that grid explains what it holds.
A command line tool, subedit-cli, carries the same operations for whole batches of files.
